lines.en: label wakanaspring4:
scene wakanaresto1
: I’m going to be frank with you, Arakawa. Never in a million years did I think you were going to remember this place — let alone take me here of your volition.
lines.zh: : 我跟你直说了吧，荒川。我打死也想不到你会记得这地方——更别说主动带我来。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you said it was one of your favorite spots and today is all about {i}you.{/i} I can be surprising every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……你说过这是你最喜欢的地方之一，而且今天的一切都是为了{i}你{/i}。我偶尔也是能让人意外的。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto2
: I suppose you can. Color me impressed. So long as that color is black, of course.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。算我惊喜到了。当然，前提是那「惊喜」得是黑色的。

lines.en: Wakana seemed rather skeptical when I insisted that we make our way to the train station, but she more or less figured out where we were going once we got off at the Urban District.
lines.zh: 我坚持要去火车站的时候，Wakana 看起来挺怀疑的；不过等我们在市区站下车，她多多少少猜到了我们要去哪儿。

lines.en: So yeah, I guess you can say this is me finally being a good Samaritan- {i}especially{/i} when it’s the second time today that I’ve done something positive without asking for anything in return.
lines.zh: 所以没错，你可以说这回我终于当了回好心人——{i}尤其{/i}这是今天第二次我不求回报地做了件好事。

lines.en: I imagine most people would just call that something along the lines of “being a good friend,” and to that I’d agree. But here’s the thing — that’s normally not me.
lines.zh: 多数人大概会把这叫做「当个好朋友」，我也同意。但问题在于——我一向不是那样的人。

lines.en: I only vaguely remembered where this place was and needed assistance along the final stretch. And even then, I didn’t recognize the shop at first glance.
lines.zh: 我对这地方的位置只有模糊的印象，最后一段还得靠她指路。即便到了门口，第一眼我也没认出这家店。

lines.en: Once we set foot inside, though, it all came rushing back. Which is why I can tell you we’re sitting at the same table we were the {i}first{/i} time we came here.
lines.zh: 可一踏进门，什么都涌回来了。所以我敢说，我们坐的就是{i}第一次{/i}来时那张桌子。

lines.en: I’m sure this is where she sits with Osako as well. And I’m sure that’s who she’d {i}rather{/i} be sitting with at this very moment.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，她跟 Osako 也坐这张桌子。也敢肯定，此刻她{i}更{/i}想与之同桌的人是 Osako。

lines.en: But she’s stuck with me...so I at least owe her a dinner she can stomach in an atmosphere she loves.
lines.zh: 但她现在只能跟我凑合……所以我至少欠她一顿她能吃得下口的晚饭，而且是在她喜欢的氛围里。

lines.en: And even if I feel out of place, it’s worth it just to see her smile.
lines.zh: 就算我自己觉得格格不入，只要能看到她笑，就值了。

lines.en: : Ever think of changing your look up? Maybe trying on something that {i}isn’t{/i} black?
lines.zh: : 你想过换换造型吗？也许试试{i}不{/i}那么黑的颜色？

lines.en: : I have that grey jacket I wear to work. Does that not suffice?
lines.zh: : 我有件上班穿的灰外套。这还不够吗？

lines.en: : Grey is just light black.
lines.zh: : 灰色只是浅一点的黑。

lines.en: : I’ve always looked at it as more of a dark white.
lines.zh: : 我一直把它看成深一点的白色。

lines.en: : Either way, I’m talking about light colors. Maybe a nice pink or red.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我说的是浅色。也许好看的粉色或者红色。

lines.en: : Sorry, are you a fashion designer now? Because, if you are, I believe you may need to head back to school to learn a thing or two about color matching.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你现在改行当服装设计师了？因为如果是的话，我觉得你大概得回学校再学学配色。

lines.en: : I think those colors would look just fine on you. I think {i}anything{/i} would look fine on you, really. You’re a beautiful girl.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那些颜色穿在你身上会很好看。我觉得真的{i}什么{/i}穿你身上都好看。你是个漂亮的女孩。

lines.en: : {i}Woman,{/i} Arakawa. I am a beautiful {i}woman.{/i} The miniature devils I {i}teach{/i} are girls.
lines.zh: : 是{i}女人{/i}，荒川。我是一个漂亮的{i}女人{/i}。我{i}教{/i}的那些小恶魔才是女孩。

lines.en: : Some of those miniature devils are taller than you.
lines.zh: : 有些小恶魔可比你高。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto3
: Yes, but that does naught to fix their elegance for I meant miniature in aura, not height.
lines.zh: : 是，可那也补救不了她们那点优雅——因为我说的「小」是指气质，不是身高。

lines.en: : Damn. Guess I’ll just have to throw away the bright yellow dress I bought you for your birthday then.
lines.zh: : 糟了。看来我得把给你买的生日亮黄裙子扔了。

lines.en: : Oh, please. I doubt you even know when my birthday {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我怀疑你根本不知道我生日{i}是{/i}哪天。

lines.en: : No. But if I had to take a guess, I’d imagine it’s just Halloween or something equally fitting.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过让我猜的话，我想大概是万圣节，或者同样贴切的什么日子。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto4
: Close enough. October 10th.
lines.zh: : 差不多。十月十号。

lines.en: : Oh, so right around the corner.
lines.zh: : 哦，那就在眼前了。

lines.en: : But not {i}so{/i} soon that you don’t have time to exchange your hypothetical dress for something more befitting a goth queen.
lines.zh: : 但也没{i}近到{/i}你来不及把那条虚构的裙子，换成更适合一位哥特女王的东西。

lines.en: : Do you actually want a birthday present?
lines.zh: : 你真的想要生日礼物吗？

lines.en: : Would you actually buy me one if I did?
lines.zh: : 我要是真想要，你真会买给我？

lines.en: : Depends. Will you buy me one for mine?
lines.zh: : 看情况。那我的那份你会不会买？

lines.en: : Depends on if I remember. When is it?
lines.zh: : 看我记不记得。你生日是哪天？

lines.en: : It’s-
scene wakanaresto5
: Do you...not remember your own birthday?
lines.zh: : 你……不记得自己的生日？

lines.en: : I...don’t think I do.
lines.zh: : 我……好像真不记得。

lines.en: : Just...look at your ID, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 那就……看看你的身份证啊，荒川。

lines.en: : I don’t keep it on me.
lines.zh: : 我没随身带。

lines.en: : What? What if you’re stopped by the police?
lines.zh: : 什么？要是被警察拦下来怎么办？

lines.en: : I guess I’m going to jail.
lines.zh: : 那我就去坐牢呗。

lines.en: : I mean, knowing you, you’d be very likely going to jail regardless. But having your ID on you would at least save some time and-
lines.zh: : 我是说，就你这种人，无论如何大概都很可能进监狱。但随身带身份证至少能省点时间，而且——

lines.en: : You know what? Forget the ID and forget my birthday. I’m buying you a present. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？别提身份证了，也别提我的生日。我要给你买礼物。你想要什么？

lines.en: scene wakanaresto6
: Someone else to talk to at work would be nice.
lines.zh: : 工作时有个能说话的人就挺好。

lines.en: : So a set of walkie-talkies for you, Imani, and Rika. Got it.
lines.zh: : 那就是给你、Imani 和 Rika 各配一台对讲机。明白了。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto7
: Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 荒川。

lines.en: : Please don’t lecture me. I’ve been so good today.
lines.zh: : 别训我。我今天表现这么好。

lines.en: : You have, which is why I’m going to be as gentle as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 你确实表现得很好，所以我会尽可能温柔地说。

lines.en: : Either you come back to school by the end of the year, or I butcher you and bury you in your own backyard.
lines.zh: : 要么你在学年结束前回来上班，要么我把你宰了，埋在你自己家后院。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} as gentle as you can be?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}已经是你能做到的最温柔了？

lines.en: : I’m a very violent woman when I’m not in crippling pain. And while I understand that you may have personal issues you need to sort out, I imagine an entire school year should suffice. Should it not?
lines.zh: : 我不痛得动不了的时候，可是个相当暴力的女人。虽然我理解你可能有私人问题要处理，但我想一整学年总该够了吧？

lines.en: : Ara-
: It just has to be by the end of the school year?
lines.zh: : 只要在学年结束前就行？

lines.en: : If you want to keep your life, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果你还想留着这条命，是的。

lines.en: : And if I don’t?
lines.zh: : 那要是不呢？

lines.en: : Then I will lace your drink with cyanide and kill you now so I don’t have to worry about you anymore.
lines.zh: : 那我就往你酒里下氰化物，现在就杀了你，省得以后还得为你操心。

lines.en: : You’d have your work cut out for you having to carry me from here all the way to my backyard.
lines.zh: : 要把我从这儿一路扛到我家后院，可有你忙的。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto3
: Which is why you should be a dear and just do as you’re told. Love, Wakana Watabe.
lines.zh: : 所以你就乖乖听话吧。爱你的，渡边 Wakana。

lines.en: : Did you just end a sentence like you’d end a letter?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是用了写信落款的方式结束一句话吗？

lines.en: : PS: Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 又及：去你的。

lines.en: : You really want me back there, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很想我回去，对吧？

lines.en: scene wakanaresto8
: Complaining to the other girls just isn’t as fun.
lines.zh: : 跟别人抱怨没那么有意思。

lines.en: : I thought you were {i}women?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不是说她们是{i}女人{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Can you look away for a moment? And also slide your drink a tad closer to me?
lines.zh: : 你能别看我一会儿吗？还有，把你的酒往我这边推一点点？

lines.en: I manage to get off easy concerning Wakana’s ultimatum.
lines.zh: 关于 Wakana 的最后通牒，我算是轻松过关了。

lines.en: Of course I have no problem agreeing to come back by the end of the school year when I know the school year {i}won’t ever end.{/i}
lines.zh: 既然我知道这个学年{i}永远不会结束{/i}，答应「学年结束前回来」当然毫无问题。

lines.en: But it’s not like I can just say that since if she {i}doesn’t{/i} interrupt me, she’ll push forward the date instead.
lines.zh: 但我{i}不{/i}能就这么说出来——因为要是没被她打断，她会把日期再往前挪。

lines.en: So I keep up the pattern-
lines.zh: 所以我维持着一贯的模式——

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: Make a promise I have no intention of keeping-
lines.zh: 许下一个我根本不打算兑现的承诺——

lines.en: : I’ll come back by the end of the school year.
lines.zh: : 我会在学年结束前回来。

lines.en: And narrowly avoid a sin by convincing myself that hiding the truth from someone is different from lying.
lines.zh: 然后靠「对别人隐瞒真相不等于说谎」这个说服自己的办法，勉强躲过一桩罪。

lines.en: : Good boy.
lines.zh: : 乖孩子。

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene wakanaresto3
: And now to drink myself into a stupor in hopes that I’ll be able to make it home without you carrying me.
lines.zh: : 现在我要把自己灌到不省人事，指望不用你扛我也能自己回家。

lines.en: : You drink as well, Arakawa. It’s on me. A reward for your rare and repeated excellence today.
lines.zh: : 你也喝吧，荒川。我请客。奖励你今天罕见地持续出色。

lines.en: : Wakana...can I ask {i}you{/i} something now?
lines.zh: : Wakana……现在我能问{i}你{/i}件事吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaresto9
: Hm?
: It’s kind of...random, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有点……突然。

lines.en: : You’re not going to crawl into my lap like I did yours, are you? Because this is hardly the place for that.
lines.zh: : 你不会要像我那样爬到我腿上吧？毕竟这儿可不合适。

lines.en: : Can you tell me about your childhood?
lines.zh: : 你能跟我讲讲你的童年吗？

lines.en: : My childhood? May I at least ask what spurred such curiosity?
lines.zh: : 我的童年？我至少可以问问，是什么勾起了这份好奇心？

lines.en: : It’s just that...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : I kind of block mine out. And there are certain things that remind me of it that make me want to know if others are-
lines.zh: : 我有点把自己的童年屏蔽掉了。而有些东西会让我想起来，让我想知道别人是不是也——

lines.en: scene wakanaresto6
: Say no more.
lines.zh: : 别再说了。

lines.en: : It all started when I was in elementary school.
lines.zh: : 一切是从我上小学时开始的。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto10
: That’s when it {i}started?{/i}
lines.zh: : 从那时候才{i}开始{/i}？

lines.en: : Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 那有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : It’s just that...most people’s lives normally start {i}before{/i} then.
lines.zh: : 只是……多数人的人生通常在那时{i}之前{/i}就开始了。

lines.en: : Yes, well, you don’t want to sit here for hours as I feverishly recant the memories of my back being cut open and meticulously fiddled with, do you?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是你总不想在这儿坐上几个小时，听我激动地细述我的背被人切开、被人精心摆弄的记忆吧？

lines.en: : You were {i}awake{/i} for all that?
lines.zh: : 那些手术你都是{i}醒着{/i}的？

lines.en: : No, I- ugh. Can I just start where I intended to start? Or would you prefer I begin writing my memoirs early for the sole purpose of appeasing you?
lines.zh: : 不是，我——唉。我能直接从我打算开始的地方开始吗？还是你更希望我提早动笔写回忆录，专程为了哄你开心？

lines.en: : Start wherever you want. I’ll stop getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 你想从哪儿开始都行。我不打岔了。

lines.en: : I just want to know if you were happy back then.
lines.zh: : 我只想知道，那时候你快乐吗。

lines.en: : I can’t quite remember...but I don’t imagine I was.
lines.zh: : 我不太记得了……但我想大概不快乐。

lines.en: : I’ve been rather “gloomy” my whole life, you see. And I imagine it was for that reason no one ever paid much attention to me.
lines.zh: : 你看，我这辈子一直挺「阴郁」的。我想正是因为这个，从来没人多注意我。

lines.en: : I imagine the Sakakibara girl from your former class would be an apt comparison. But she seems to have found her footing and begun to associate with others in a way {i}I{/i} never really did.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}想你以前班上那个榊原家的女孩是个很贴切的类比。不过她似乎已经站稳了脚跟，开始跟别人来往了——而我从来没做到过。

lines.en: : There were those who tried to tease me for the way I dressed...the things I read and wrote...but they gave up and left once they realized it didn’t particularly bother me.
lines.zh: : 也有人因为我的穿着、我读和写的东西而取笑我……但他们发现我根本不在乎，就放弃了、走开了。

lines.en: : Were you just...too focused on something else back then?
lines.zh: : 你只是……当时太专注于别的事了吗？

lines.en: : I believe it would be more accurate to say I just...wasn’t focused on anything?
lines.zh: : 我觉得更准确的说法是，我当时……什么都不专注？

lines.en: : I was assuredly an outcast. But I believe at least half of that was due to an overwhelming disinterest in practically everything — with the second half being my inability to physically act as others my age did.
lines.zh: : 我无疑是个被排斥的人。但我认为其中至少一半源于我对几乎所有事情的极度不感兴趣——另一半则是我没法像同龄人那样做出那些肢体动作。

lines.en: : I was, by all accounts, the “weird” girl. But I was one who was mostly left to her own devices so...perhaps {i}that{/i} is why I blossomed into the poetic genius you see before you today.
lines.zh: : 从各方面说，我都是那个「古怪」的女孩。但我基本是被放任着长大的，所以……也许{i}正因如此{/i}，我才绽放成了你今天眼前这位诗歌天才。

lines.en: : You don’t have any pictures you can show me, do you?
lines.zh: : 你没有可以给我看的照片吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. Who just carries around pictures of their younger self all day?
lines.zh: : 当然没有。谁会整天随身带着自己小时候的照片？

lines.en: : Well...you’re all on social media, aren’t you? You don’t have anything there?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你们都在社交媒体上吧？你那儿什么都没有？

lines.en: : Every picture I have ever posted has been a flower. If anyone would like to see my face, they are free to do so in real life.
lines.zh: : 我发过的每一张照片都是花。谁想看我的脸，欢迎在现实生活里来看。

lines.en: : You know, maybe you weren’t just the “weird girl” back then because you kept to yourself. Maybe you’re just...genuinely weird.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许你当年不光是因为不合群才是「古怪女孩」。也许你就是……真的古怪。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto11
: Maybe. For it was all the same throughout high school and most of college as well.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。因为整个高中、以及大学的大部分时间都是这样。

lines.en: : But again, that never bothered me. People are just...irritating. Especially when they’re that young.
lines.zh: : 不过再说一次，那从来没困扰过我。人就是……烦人。尤其在他们那么年轻的时候。

lines.en: : They’re always whining about a need to “connect” with someone...and how it’s {i}so hard{/i} to find people who actually “understand” them.
lines.zh: : 他们总抱怨需要跟某个人「建立联系」……抱怨{i}很难{/i}找到真正「理解」他们的人。

lines.en: : But when their entire evaluation of a person is decided within the first ten seconds of meeting them, of {i}course{/i} they’re not going to be understood. Connections take time.
lines.zh: : 可要是他们对一个人的全部判断在见面的头十秒内就定下来了，他们{i}当然{/i}不会被理解。建立联系是需要时间的。

lines.en: : Those sorts of relationships where everything just clicks right away without any effort on {i}anyone’s{/i} end just...don’t exist. They’re all made up. Mostly by terrible writers looking to cash in on romance.
lines.zh: : 那种{i}什么都没付出{/i}就立刻一拍即合的关系……根本不存在。全是编出来的。多半是那些想靠浪漫赚一笔的糟糕作家编的。

lines.en: : Or...at least that’s what I {i}thought.{/i}
lines.zh: : 或者……至少我曾经是这么{i}想{/i}的。

lines.en: : Next — Osako Osaka, reading “To the River” by Edgar Allan Poe.
lines.zh: : 下一位——逢坂 Osako，朗读埃德加·爱伦·坡的《致河》。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto12
: Mm?
scene wakanaresto13
: Uhh...hi...
: That part’s...not in the poem...
lines.zh: : 那一段……诗里没有……

lines.en: : Just...
scene wakanaresto14
: Hahahaha! Classic Osako! Awkward as always!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！Osako 老样子！一如既往的尴尬！

lines.en: : You got this, Osako! Just do it like you did in the locker room!
lines.zh: : 你可以的，Osako！就像在更衣室里那样做就行！

lines.en: : Miss Osaka...if you’re unprepared for the assignment, please just say so instead of wasting everyone’s time.
lines.zh: : 逢坂同学……如果你没准备好这次作业，就直说，别浪费大家的时间。

lines.en: : I can do it! I can do it.
lines.zh: : 我能行！我能行的。

lines.en: : Then put the notebook down...
lines.zh: : 那把笔记本放下……

lines.en: : Can I just...hold onto it for comfort, please? I promise I won’t look.
lines.zh: : 我能不能就……拿着它壮壮胆？我保证不看。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto15
: {i}No.{/i} If you’re unwilling to do the assignment as instructed-
lines.zh: : {i}不行。{/i}如果你不愿意按要求完成作业——

lines.en: : Aaah! Fine!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！好吧！

lines.en: : Fair river! in thy bright, clear flow...Of crystal, wandering water...Thou art an emblem of the glow...Of beauty—the unhidden heart...The playful maziness of art...In old Alberto’s daughter...
lines.zh: : 秀美的河流！在你明亮清澈的水流中...似蜿蜒的水晶...你是那光辉的象征...是美的象征——那不加掩饰的心...是老 Alberto 女儿身上...那顽皮曲折的韵致...

lines.en: scene wakanaresto16
: B-But when within thy wave she looks...Which glistens then, and trembles...Why, then, the prettiest of brooks...Her worshipper resembles...
lines.zh: : 可、可当她向你的波心张望...水光便闪动、颤栗...于是啊，最美的小溪...便酷似那崇拜她的人...

lines.en: : For in my heart, as in thy stream...Her image deeply lies...His heart which trembles at the beam...Of her soul-searching eyes...
lines.zh: : 因为在我心里，正如在你的水流中...她的影像深深躺卧...他的心在那光束下颤栗...那是她洞彻灵魂的眼睛...

lines.en: scene wakanaresto17
: {i}Is she looking at somebody? Why’s she still just standing there?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她在看谁呢？怎么还站那儿不动？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Watabe, probably. She’s always looking at her. Have you seriously never noticed before?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概是渡边吧。她老是看她。你真的一次都没注意到？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What? Really? The creepy girl? Why? They’re totally different types.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？真的假的？那个阴森的女生？为什么？她们完全不是一个类型的啊。{/i}

lines.en: : Miss Osaka, well done. But if that will be all...please take your seat.
lines.zh: : 逢坂同学，做得很好。不过如果到此为止的话……请回座位吧。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto18
: S...Sorry! Bye!
lines.zh: : 对……对不起！再见！

lines.en: scene wakanaresto19
: Perhaps there {i}is{/i} some truth to immediately knowing whether or not you’ll “click” with a person...
lines.zh: : 也许「第一眼就知道你会不会跟某个人合拍」这句话，{i}还真{/i}有几分道理……

lines.en: : Because from that point on, my life has been {i}full{/i} of color thanks to a bashful, yet sensitive jock with a secret affinity for sage and lace. And if I could go back and do it all again, I would.
lines.zh: : 因为从那一刻起，我的人生就被一个害羞又敏感的体育生{i}填满{/i}了色彩——而这人还偷偷迷恋鼠尾草绿和蕾丝。要是能重来一次，我还是会这么选。

lines.en: : They can cut me open as many times as they want and I’ll keep looking forward to it because I know what lies ahead. And it’s something unlike anything else in the world.
lines.zh: : 他们想剖开我多少次都行，我会一直盼着那一刻，因为我知道前面等着的是什么。那是世上任何东西都比不了的。

lines.en: scene wakanaresto20
: I apologize if that wasn’t the sort of nostalgic retelling you were hoping for, Arakawa. I have no traumatic tale of neglect or abuse or anything else you could have hopefully connected with.
lines.zh: : 如果这番怀旧不是你期待的那种，我先道歉，荒川。我没有什么被冷落、被虐待之类的创伤故事，也没有什么能让你感同身受的东西。

lines.en: : But I hope with this shriveled, blackened heart of mine that, one day, you will have a moment like I did — where you see someone or something for the first time and think “this is why I’m here.”
lines.zh: : 但我用这颗干瘪发黑的心希望着：有一天，你也会经历我那样的瞬间——第一次看见某个人或某样东西，然后想「这就是我在这里的原因」。

lines.en: : Perhaps you already have and simply haven’t told me. There {i}is{/i} that childhood friend of yours, after all. And many others too.
lines.zh: : 也许你早就有了，只是没告诉我。毕竟你{i}有{/i}那位青梅竹马。还有别的许多人。

lines.en: : I’m not looking to know everything — just what you’re willing to share.
lines.zh: : 我并不想什么都知道——只要是你愿意说的就够了。

lines.en: : And I may not have enough happiness for the two of us right now...
lines.zh: : 而现在，我也许没有足够的幸福分给我们两个人……

lines.en: : But if I ever do, I hope you’ll take some of it off my hands.
lines.zh: : 但如果有朝一日够了，我希望你能从我这儿分走一些。

lines.en: : I can only smile for so long until my face begins to hurt.
lines.zh: : 我能笑的时间有限，笑久了脸就开始疼。

lines.en: : Maybe one day.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天吧。

lines.en: : Maybe, indeed.
lines.zh: : 确实，也许。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana and I finish our respective meals before she takes out her phone and begins to scroll through every photo she has ever posted to social media.
lines.zh: Wakana 和我各自吃完饭，然后她掏出手机，开始翻她发到社交媒体上的每一张照片。

lines.en: Each one is just as she said — a flower.
lines.zh: 每一张都跟她说的一样——一朵花。

lines.en: But there’s only one that brings me hope. Or joy, if you could call it that.
lines.zh: 但其中只有一张给我希望。或者说喜悦，如果你愿意这么叫的话。

lines.en: I ask her if she’ll send it to me and she smiles.
lines.zh: 我问她能不能发给我，她笑了。

lines.en: Then, we take the train back to the first half of town.
lines.zh: 然后我们坐电车回到城镇的另一半。

lines.en: I carry her for the last block on the way to her apartment, but I probably didn’t have to.
lines.zh: 去她公寓的最后一段路我背了她，虽然也许根本没必要。

lines.en: When we get to her door, I exercise a brand new right of mine.
lines.zh: 到了她家门口，我用了一项刚到手不久的新权利。

lines.en: I imagine it will happen again.
lines.zh: 我想这种事以后还会发生。

lines.en: Then, I gaze at that photo all the way home.
lines.zh: 然后，我一路回家都盯着那张照片看。

lines.en: It isn’t why I’m here.
lines.zh: 它不是我在这里的原因。

lines.en: But it’s close.
lines.zh: 但很接近了。

lines.en: I can feel it.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到。
